family: External U.S. 10-year par real Treasury yield shock
counting: One macro family regardless of direction or instrument; never count a retrospective screen as validated.

sources.gold: D:/openclaude/Nova pasta/SNIPER_XAUUSD/calibration/XAUUSD_H1.csv; verify SHA-256 against the original selection.json and research/gold-h1-v2-selection.json
sources.treasuryDefinition: Daily Treasury Par Real Yield Curve Rates, 10 YR, percent per year; not assumed identical to FRED DFII10
sources.treasuryVintage: Historical publication timestamp and point-in-time vintages unavailable. The lag below is a conservative rule, not a proof of causal historical availability.
sources.brokerClock: The exported XAU H1 time labels are used as broker calendar labels. Their actual timezone/UTC offset is unverified.

laterPeriods: Do not evaluate 2016 onward automatically. Development failure ends this trial; even a development pass awaits independent audit of data, time mapping and risk.

signal.decisionTime: After H1 08:00–09:00 broker-labeled bar closes; execute no earlier than contiguous 09:00 broker open.
signal.observationChoice: For broker date d choose latest Treasury observation dated <= d minus 7 CALENDAR days, and no earlier than d minus 14 CALENDAR days. If absent, no signal.
signal.delta: Chosen 10 YR percent yield minus yield five earlier OBSERVATIONS in the Treasury series, in percentage points. Require all six dated rows; no calendar interpolation.
signal.otherwise: No signal; no extra price, trend, volume, holiday or market-session filters.
signal.missingOrGap: The legacy engine requires the next contiguous same-day H1 open, otherwise skips; never backfill a candle.

bracket.atr: ATR14 Wilder over completed exported H1 bars, computed by gold_signals.atr
bracket.stop: Signal close minus 2*ATR14 for long, plus 2*ATR14 for short; engine rounds stop outward to 0.01 and validates bracket at actual entry.
bracket.target: 2 times the actual entry-to-rounded-stop distance, recomputed at entry by engine reward=2
bracket.cutoff: 20:00 broker-labeled time under gold_h1_execution.simulate; observed gaps follow that engine's exit policy.
bracket.intrabar: Stop first if stop and target both in one H1; intrabar path and exact fills unknown.

execution.engine: scripts/gold_h1_execution.py unchanged; MAX_LEVERAGE set to 1.0 in research process before simulation
execution.actualRisk: 0.01-lot steps and 100%-notional ceiling may size below USD250; never increase leverage to force full risk.
execution.costCaveat: Research assumptions, not certified contract costs; overnight swap unavailable.

developmentScreen.drawdownMetricCaveat: Legacy conservativeDrawdown measures adverse H1 bound against peaks at observed opens/closes, not the true maximum intrabar peak-to-trough drawdown; passing this proxy cannot certify the 8%/10% gate.

approval: A development pass only requests independent root audit. No point-in-time claim, untouched OOS, operational approval or increment to the seven-strategy count follows from this run.
